headline: I think in systems.
I ship for people.

stats.label: Production apps on the App Store & Play Store

paragraphs: I'm a Software Engineer working across Next.js and React Native - building interfaces and the systems behind them. I care about the layer where a technical decision turns into something a person actually feels: a load time, a transition that doesn't jank, a form that doesn't fight you.

This site is one example. The sky you're scrolling through runs on a single shared timeline, not an animation library - the sun and moon share one interpolation function, the constellations are canvas, not DOM, and every animated detail has a reduced-motion alternative. Those choices keep the experience expressive without making it fragile.
closing: Thoughtful by design. Curious by default.
